parrafo.es: Melvin Auto Detailing LLC atiende Kissimmee, Orlando y alrededores con servicio móvil real: el equipo llega hasta donde estés con todo lo necesario para dejar tu auto impecable, por dentro y por fuera.
parrafo.en: Melvin Auto Detailing LLC serves Kissimmee, Orlando and the surrounding area with a true mobile service: the crew comes to you with everything needed to leave your car looking its best, inside and out.

parrafo_1.es: Melvin Auto Detailing LLC es un servicio móvil de detailing con base en Kissimmee, FL. El mismo Melvin llega a cada cita, revisa el vehículo y hace el trabajo: sin subcontratistas ni intermediarios.
parrafo_1.en: Melvin Auto Detailing LLC is a mobile detailing service based in Kissimmee, FL. Melvin himself shows up to every appointment, looks over the vehicle and does the work: no subcontractors, no middlemen.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google lo describen como meticuloso y profesional, alguien que cuida cada detalle y da recomendaciones honestas sin presionar con servicios extra. Con 153 reseñas y calificación perfecta de 5.0, es de los detailers mejor valorados de la zona de Kissimmee y Orlando.
parrafo_2.en: Clients on Google describe him as meticulous and professional, someone who pays attention to every detail and gives honest recommendations without pushing extra services. With 153 reviews and a perfect 5.0 rating, he is one of the highest rated detailers in the Kissimmee and Orlando area.

texto.es: Eliges el paquete, el tipo de vehículo y el horario que te convenga desde la página de reservas.
texto.en: You pick the package, your vehicle type and a time that works for you from the online booking page.

texto.es: El equipo llega a tu casa o trabajo con agua, equipo y productos profesionales, sin que tengas que moverte.
texto.en: The crew arrives at your home or office with water, equipment and professional-grade products, no need for you to go anywhere.

texto.es: Desde un lavado esencial hasta un detallado completo con cerámico: cada paso se hace con calma y cuidado.
texto.en: From an essential wash to a full detail with ceramic coating: every step is done with care and without rushing.

texto.es: Revisas el resultado junto a Melvin antes de que se vaya. Si algo no te convence, te lo soluciona ahí mismo.
texto.en: You walk the result together with Melvin before he leaves. If something is not right, he fixes it on the spot.

nota.es: Precios de sedán tomados del menú publicado en la reserva online. SUV, 3 filas, pickup y pickup elevada tienen un ajuste por tamaño de vehículo; el detalle completo con todos los add-ons aparece al reservar.
nota.en: Prices shown are for sedans, taken from the published online booking menu. SUVs, 3-row vehicles, trucks and lifted trucks are priced a bit higher by size; the full breakdown with every add-on shows up when you book.

texto.es: Descontaminación de hierro y arcilla, cera hidrofóbica aplicada a mano, acondicionado de cuero, aspirado profundo y limpieza a vapor de zonas de contacto.
texto.en: Iron and clay decontamination, a hand-applied hydrophobic wax, leather conditioning, deep vacuuming and steam cleaning of high-touch areas.

texto.es: Lavado a mano en dos cubetas, limpieza de rines y pozos de rueda, aspirado y limpieza interior, y protección UV en plásticos.
texto.en: Two-bucket hand wash, wheel and wheel-well cleaning, interior vacuum and wipe-down, and UV protection on plastics.

texto.es: Descontaminación completa con arcilla, restauración de faros, detallado de motor, sellador hidrofóbico y shampoo de alfombras y tapetes.
texto.en: Full clay bar decontamination, headlight restoration, an engine bay detail, a hydrophobic spray topper and a carpet and floor mat shampoo.

texto.es: Pulido de un paso, cerámico de 12 meses sobre la pintura, protección hidrofóbica premium y protección de plásticos del motor.
texto.en: One-step paint enhancement polish, a 12-month ceramic coating on the paint, premium hydrophobic protection and engine plastic protection.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu tipo de vehículo? El menú completo, con precios por SUV, 3 filas, pickup y pickup elevada, está disponible al reservar en línea.
pie.en: Do not see your vehicle type? The full menu, with pricing for SUVs, 3-row vehicles, trucks and lifted trucks, is available when you book online.

items.quote: If you are in the Orlando/ Kissimmee area looking for a luxury Car detailer, hit up Melvin auto Detailing. Easy, smooth, professional and great experience. Paid attention to details and he was very reasonable with his pricing. He was meticulous! Highly recommend him

If you want someone who cares about the little details, this is it! Second car done by Melvin and he never disappoints. Left my car looking better than when I purchased it. He's efficient, profesional, friendly and all around a great guy, you can tell he loves what he does, and that makes all the difference.

If you're looking for a committed, hardworking detailing professional, Melvin is the one. He takes pride in his work and even gives helpful suggestions for your car's future detailing needs without trying to push extra services on you. He's not like a "car dealer" trying to upsell everything, and to me, that says a lot about his honesty and professionalism.
